title: Student Report
hints: Turn every line into a Grade record first; then each part of the report is one stream over the list.
groupingBy(Grade::course, TreeMap::new, toList()) gives the courses in alphabetical order with their grades.
For "best", sort with Comparator.comparingInt(Grade::score).reversed().thenComparing(Grade::student) and take findFirst().
Student averages: groupingBy(Grade::student, averagingInt(Grade::score)). The top student is the highest average, ties broken by name.

pt-br.title: Relatório da turma
hints: Transforme cada linha em um record Grade primeiro; depois cada parte do relatório é um stream sobre a lista.
groupingBy(Grade::course, TreeMap::new, toList()) dá as matérias em ordem alfabética com as notas.
Para o "best", ordene com Comparator.comparingInt(Grade::score).reversed().thenComparing(Grade::student) e pegue findFirst().
Médias dos alunos: groupingBy(Grade::student, averagingInt(Grade::score)). O melhor aluno tem a maior média, com empate decidido pelo nome.
mustContain: Use a Stream API para montar o relatório.
mustNotContain: Monte o relatório com streams: sem laços for ou while.

mustContain.message: Use the Stream API to build the report.

mustNotContain.message: Build the report with streams: no for or while loops.
